summary: High Moon Studios' vampire western first-person shooter for PlayStation 2 and Xbox.

entries.title: Darkwatch
entries.definitive_edition: Xbox for main play; PS2 for exclusive co-op

emulation.emulator: xemu for Xbox or PCSX2 for PS2 where legal and stable
emulation.notes: Use xemu/Xbox for the main run; use PCSX2/PS2 for co-op preservation.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Xbox release with emulator scaling; PS2 for co-op only

primary.why: Darkwatch released on PlayStation 2 and Xbox. Xbox is the primary route for single-player fidelity and online multiplayer preservation, while PS2 has the notable exclusive split-screen story co-op mode.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox version for the main run; play the PS2 version only if you specifically want its split-screen story co-op.

secondary.exclusive_content: Split-screen story co-op absent from the Xbox version
secondary.what_to_play: Try the PS2 co-op campaign mode if preserving the co-op variant matters.
secondary.why: The PS2 version includes split-screen story co-op, while the Xbox version has stronger multiplayer/network features and is the main-route pick.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Xbox release with online competitive multiplayer support in the original release.
all_releases.reason: primary: best main-route pick for fidelity and network multiplayer preservation.

all_releases.fidelity: Original PS2 release with split-screen story co-op but no online connectivity.
all_releases.reason: secondary: story co-op is exclusive to PS2, but Xbox remains the main-route pick.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Xbox is the better main route and has online multiplayer history; PS2 uniquely has split-screen story co-op, so treat PS2 as a secondary co-op route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is documented in the cited public source.
